personal_info.title: Generative AI & LLM Engineer
personal_info.summary: Generative AI Engineer specialized in building production-ready RAG pipelines, autonomous multi-agent workflows, LLM fine-tuning, and robust guardrail systems. Passionate about transforming cutting-edge foundation models into reliable, high-throughput, latency-optimized software architectures.

career_preferences.relocation: Open to relocation for the right opportunity

genai_and_llm: Guardrails (NeMo, Guardrails AI, Llama Guard, Custom Pydantic Validators)
vector_databases_and_retrieval: BM25 / Hybrid Search & Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)

responsibilities: Architected and deployed production RAG systems with hybrid lexical-semantic search, achieving 94% retrieval accuracy.
Integrated dual-stage input/output guardrails mitigating jailbreak attempts, prompt injection, and hallucinated responses.
Implemented continuous AI evaluation pipelines using Ragas and LLM-as-a-judge to track answer faithfulness, context precision, and latency.
Engineered autonomous multi-agent workflows using LangGraph with state persistence and human-in-the-loop validation.
Optimized inference cost and token consumption by 35% through prompt compression, semantic caching, and dynamic model routing.
Built and maintained high-throughput RESTful microservices using FastAPI, handling over 1M requests daily with sub-80ms p95 latency.
Developed end-to-end data processing pipelines for structured and unstructured document ingestion.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate NLP models into enterprise customer support and internal knowledge search.
Set up automated CI/CD testing suites reducing production deployment regressions by 40%.

featured_projects.title: Enterprise Recruiter RAG & Portfolio Representative

Sub-second response streaming with source attribution and citations.

key_highlights: Stateful cyclic graph execution with deterministic rollback and checkpointing.
Automated tool calling with rate-limit resiliency and provider failover.
Evaluation benchmark against standard agentic reasoning benchmarks.

key_highlights: Dynamic provider health checks and intelligent fallback upon rate-limiting (429s).
Semantic caching reducing repeated prompt costs to zero.

recruiter_faq.question: Why should we hire Dinesh for a Generative AI / LLM role?
recruiter_faq.answer: Dinesh combines strong software engineering discipline (FastAPI, Docker, async patterns) with modern GenAI expertise (RAG architectures, hybrid retrieval, agentic systems, guardrails, and evals). He builds production-grade, reliable systems that move beyond simple prototypes into battle-tested products.

recruiter_faq.question: What is Dinesh's experience with RAG and Vector Databases?
recruiter_faq.answer: Dinesh has built production RAG systems leveraging hybrid search (BM25 + Chroma/Qdrant), reciprocal rank fusion, contextual re-ranking, and metadata filtering. He actively addresses chunking strategies, embedding alignment, and hallucination reduction.

recruiter_faq.question: How does Dinesh ensure LLM applications are safe and production-ready?
recruiter_faq.answer: He implements defense-in-depth guardrails: input validation for prompt injection/jailbreak detection, topic enforcement, and output verification for hallucination and persona consistency. He also establishes continuous AI evaluation suites (Ragas/DeepEval) into CI pipelines.

recruiter_faq.question: What are his notice period and availability?
recruiter_faq.answer: Dinesh is ready to discuss opportunities immediately and has a flexible transition/notice window (typically immediate to 15-30 days).
